text: Slice 378 exit: source code defines Collar point extension as the horizontal delta of upperCollar.frontTip with its POM anchor at that edge's end. Exact-source replay of all 17 Polo options reproduces two measured base-render TEXT_COLLISION rows: standFrontRise max (1.5 cm extension) and collarPointExtension min (0.5 cm). A diagnostic C marker at the exact same-revision source endpoint with the unchanged full POM in a bottom keyed row renders 17/17 and clears those two local renderer errors. Manually reviewed default and both failure whole/detail/schedule views; other crowded collar/placket crossings remain, so this is not an overall readability pass or V02 acceptance. Colorway fill is omitted. No production source, geometry, POM, export or board acceptance changed; retain all 34 Polo holds and the fixed 0.25 cm residual gate. Integrated tally remains 56 accepted / 90 held. S373 Woven overlap decision remains pending. See S378 packet and option/output matrix.
